name: claude-code-fuel-gauge
description: Live context %, cache countdown, model and effort level, and usage limits for Claude Code — in your VS Code status bar.

fuel-gauge.pollInterval.description: How often to check for context updates (in seconds)

fuel-gauge.warningThreshold.description: Percentage at which the indicator turns yellow

fuel-gauge.dangerThreshold.description: Percentage at which the indicator turns red

fuel-gauge.systemOverhead.description: A number of tokens to subtract from the size of the context window before Brain Drain works out the percentage. You no longer need this: Brain Drain now shows the percentage Claude Code itself reports. A value you set here is used only when Claude Code sends no percentage of its own, which almost never happens.
fuel-gauge.systemOverhead.deprecationMessage: Brain Drain no longer needs this setting and you can safely remove it. It now shows the same context percentage that Claude Code's /context command and status line report, so there is nothing left to correct for. A value you set here still works, but only when Claude Code sends no percentage of its own.

fuel-gauge.cacheTTL.description: How long Claude Code's prompt cache lives, in seconds. Leave this empty and Brain Drain reads the answer from Claude Code itself: it records which cache it asked for on every turn. Set a number here only to override that — 300 for five minutes, 3600 for one hour.

fuel-gauge.cacheWarningSeconds.description: Play 3 short beeps when the cache countdown drops below this threshold (in seconds). Leave null to disable. macOS only (uses afplay). Example: 180 for a 3-minute warning.

fuel-gauge.effortStyle.description: Show the active model + reasoning-effort level as a compact status bar item (e.g. 'opus·x-high'), color-coded by effort level (low → medium → high → x-high → max). 'text' = show it, 'off' = hide it. The effort part only appears when the current Claude Code model exposes an effort level; hover for the full model / effort / context / cache breakdown.

fuel-gauge.showUsage.description: Show your Claude plan's usage limits — session (5-hour) and weekly percentage used, with reset times — in the gauge's hover tooltip. When a limit gets high, a colored alert dot appears in the status bar (yellow at 70% used, red at 90%). Only available on subscription plans (Pro/Max), once Claude Code reports limit data.

fuel-gauge.manageStatusLine.description: Let Brain Drain use Claude Code's status line slot in ~/.claude/settings.json. Claude Code allows only one status line command. Turn this off and Brain Drain stays out of that file; the gauge then shows a warning icon that you can click to connect. Your previous command is saved and can be put back with "Brain Drain: Restore Previous Status Line".
